title: Software Delivery Crew
subtitle: This crew of five takes a plan and turns it into working code: a planner writes the tasks, a builder writes the code, a reviewer reads every critical path, a researcher answers "what else does this touch", and an inspector checks the finished work before it is accepted.
lede: This crew of five takes a plan and turns it into working code: a planner writes the tasks, a builder writes the code, a reviewer reads every critical path, a researcher answers "what else does this touch", and an inspector checks the finished work before it is accepted.
who: A founder or CTO with a large build and a small team
author: Corey James
